limits_of_evidence: Input byte counts do not measure peak build usage, generated output, SDK extraction, or downloaded assets.
Positive input evidence is not a successful compile, emulator run, head-unit installation, registration, or functional test.
All unit-build and live-installation results are NOT_OBSERVED.
A source fetch or build failure may cause Store to retry the whole repository, which exceeds the default build byte budget in this observation.
